name: Iguaçu National Park
description: In southern Brazil's Paraná State, this rainforest park holds its share of Iguaçu Falls, a curtain of waterfalls stretching about 2,700 metres along the border with Argentina. Mist from the plunging water keeps the surrounding forest thick and green. Giant otters and giant anteaters, both rare, live among the trees beyond the viewing walkways.
